item.title: Some royal 'rubies' turned out to be spinel
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Several famous historical stones called rubies are actually natural spinel, a mineral separate from ruby corundum.
EXIMUTC view: Demand gem identification rather than relying on historical trade names.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/spinel

item.title: Tanzanite was discovered in Tanzania in 1967
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: This violet-blue variety of zoisite was discovered in 1967 near Mount Kilimanjaro and subsequently gained international attention.
EXIMUTC view: The discovery story concerns the variety; an individual stone still needs its own treatment and identity disclosures.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/tanzanite
